__prompts__.project_name: Project name, as people write it
__prompts__.project_slug: Project slug (the board label and session names use it)
__prompts__.repo_base: Repository base name (may differ from the slug)
__prompts__.ml_pytorch: Include PyTorch, with seeding, device checks and run records?
__prompts__.cuda_source: Where Linux gets torch: PyPI (CUDA 13, driver 580+) or the CUDA 12.6 index
__prompts__.public_docs: Publish documentation (MkDocs site, how-to guides, community files)? Turn on later with cruft update
__prompts__.docs_theme: Documentation theme (change later with cruft update --variables-to-update)
__prompts__.contact_email: Email for conduct and security reports (required with public docs; type it, there is no default)
__prompts__.run_records: Write a run record (a witness file and a metrics file) for every run? (needs PyTorch)
__prompts__.dataset_registry: Is this repository the project's root, holding its dataset registry (a lab project; a paper project's workspace holds it instead)?
